title: League of Legends Patch 26.18 Notes
description: Everything is where it belongs: Caps is in the Hall of Legends, Demacians are back in Classic, and ARAM Mayhem augments are on the right champions!

entries.context: LoL Esports inducts a pro player into the Hall of Legends to honor their achievements within the sport and game. Players are chosen by an independent voting panel of esports industry veterans and experts from every region who select players based on criteria including international berths, international and regional titles, role-specific stats, and overall contributions to the sport. We're honored to announce that Rasmus "Caps" Winther is the third inductee into the Hall of Legends! Known as a Beacon of Hope whose legacy reshaped what the West believed was possible on the global stage, Caps becomes the first Western League of Legends pro to earn the distinction. Widely regarded as the defining Western player of his generation, Caps built his legacy through a rare blend of elite skill, creativity, and authenticity. From his meteoric rise as a rookie to becoming the most decorated player in European League of Legends history, Caps has consistently proven he can stand toe-to-toe with the world's best while staying true to his own style. The in-game Hall of Legends event pass celebrates Caps' countless accomplishments and takes you on a journey through his career. You can earn and purchase commemorative cosmetic items and an exclusive skin themed after the Beacon of Hope himself in celebration of this moment. Also available are the Risen Legend, Immortalized Legend, and Signature Immortalized Legend Collections, featuring Tristana skins co-developed with Caps himself. Experience the fearless blend of creativity, adaptability, and unbridled enthusiasm that characterizes Caps' career in the Hall of Legends battle pass with 100 total levels of unlockable rewards, including commemorative skins, icons, and an exclusive callback honoring an iconic Caps champion. Reward highlights include:

changes.text: Freljord Taliyah, Elderwood LeBlanc, Empyrean Akali Skins

entries.name: Bard
entries.context: Bard has been a meta staple for much of the year. Earlier we toned his damage down to what we think are reasonable levels, so this time we are going to target his durability which has also stood out as high given his mobility and long range ultimate utility.

entries.name: Cassiopeia
entries.context: Cassio has always scaled with skill, but this year has propelled her to new heights of pro play dominance despite being weaker for average players. These adjustments should tap down her laning power, especially in pro where defensive purchases are valued more than raw AP, while giving her back some scaling power. It will still be critical to use empowered E's, but raising her floor lets us be a bit more flexible with tuning.

changes.text: Move Speed Bonus: 6% - 40% (based on level) ⇒ 5% - 36% (based on level)
changes.label: Move Speed Bonus

entries.name: Ekko
entries.context: As one of our assassins that offer opponents a wider mix of gameplay options, Ekko has found a slightly weak steady state since Dusk & Dawn's update mid year. We believe he has some room for power, especially in mid where he scales slightly worse, without buffing his Hail of Blades pattern.

entries.name: Kassadin
entries.context: Kassadin had a strong start to 2026 but hasn't regained his…footing…since our earlier nerfs. His Q should feel more punchy with his scaling, and we're aiming to provide more early agency through good Riftwalk usage without touching his late game fantasy.

entries.name: Master Yi
entries.context: Yi drew the short end of the stick on the Rageblade bugfix from earlier this year due to his double strike interactions. While the actual impact for most Rageblade users was minor (and we are compensating Rageblade as well for that this patch), he was impacted harder than the other users. He's also just been unable to scale as well as a melee carry compared to his normal power level, so we are also giving him a buff up.

entries.name: Nautilus
entries.context: Nautilus has been sitting near the top of the meta for the entire year, even before our work to bring other tank supports up in power, and we feel nerfing him will open up room for a more variety. That said, we know a lot of his value is in being able to lock down champions effectively, and that'll remain a core strength.

entries.name: Seraphine
entries.context: Seraphine bot has been a source of frustration for opponents for some time, despite a minor nerf a few patches ago. We are nerfing her E's rank up to target this head on, as support Seraphine usually maxes it last (which basically means she never has it maxed as a support.)

entries.name: Syndra
entries.context: Our MSI changes were effective at pulling her to the forefront of pro play for the first time in years, but unfortunately she's too performant in specific solo queue settings. Our data shows that W damage is a meaningfully larger share of damage in the tiers where she's stronger than desired, so this should help tap her down while still preserving her core fantasies. Her passive is also now better breakpointed to increase reliance on Lost Chapter in early-mid levels, nerfing her higher winrate builds that make do with less mana investment.

entries.name: Viego
entries.context: Viego's winrate has been on a downward trend recently, and his players have noticed and begun dropping him. He has a fair bit of room to bring up, both just generally and for the viability of his more bruisery alt build.

changes.text: Heal: 2% (+…. ) ⇒ 2% (+ 2.5% per 100 bonus AD) (+ 2% per 100 AP) (+ 5% per 100% bonus attack speed) (+ 2% per 500 bonus HP) of the target's maximum health
changes.label: Heal
changes.after: 2% (+ 2.5% per 100 bonus AD) (+ 2% per 100 AP) (+ 5% per 100% bonus attack speed) (+ 2% per 500 bonus HP) of the target's maximum health

entries.name: Zaahen
entries.context: We're using a QoL change here as an opportunity to give Zaahen some love! This might read as a nerf, but Zaahen's Q lined up with his passive in such a way that it meant he always left his resurrection (and GA, Zilean R) with Q on CD, so now he's always happier. His Q2 is also a clean double of his Q1 base damage now.

changes.text: NEW Cooldown Behavior: If Q is active, it is now placed on Cooldown immediately upon being put in Resurrection
changes.label: NEW Cooldown Behavior
changes.before: If Q is active, it is now placed on Cooldown immediately upon being put in Resurrection

entries.name: Zeri
entries.context: Zeri has been slowly climbing in winrate with the recent Runaan's Hurricane and Yun Tal Wildarrows buffs. She now sits very high in winrate compared to her historical resting, which is worrying for a champ that is so skill intensive. As she has also begun showing up in pro, we expect she has a high chance of becoming meta dominant, so we are pulling some power out of her burst and waveclear.

entries.name: Guinsoo's Rageblade
entries.context: In light of the bugfix nerfing rageblade by a minor amount by pushing back when the first double hit triggers, we are compensating with a similarly minor QoL buff to help players get it stacked up and keep it stacked.

Thank you, Summoners, for casting your votes in the inaugural Council! We aggregated the results from across the world and you can read them below. The questions with actionable results will be released in an upcoming patch, specifically:

changes.text: 1. Yes – Add modern jungle timers that are always visible on the minimap - 45.74%
2. Yes – Only when the scoreboard is open - 23.46%
Fixed a bug where Teemo's traps did not last the appropriate 10 minutes.
Fixed a bug where Akali's Q cast indicator did not accurately reflect its cast range.
Fixed a bug where Akali's W could be cast while moving.
Fixed a bug where Akali's R cast indicator did not accurately reflect its cast range.
Fixed a bug where Skarner's E could heal for less than the full amount.
Fixed a bug where Nidalee's Cougar E hit range was 310 instead of 350.
Fixed a bug where Nidalee's Human E cast range was 900 instead of 600.

entries.context: Hello Mayhemers! In this patch, we're making more behind-the-scenes adjustments to Augment offerings. We've heard your feedback around some Augments showing up on champions that don't make sense on them, such as AP-focused Augments on Vayne. We're taking another pass at these cases and will continue improving the Augment pools to provide more relevant and exciting choices for each champion. For bugfixes, we've also addressed a few unintended interactions with Ultra Hydra and Ravenous Hydra that could be abused for some…questionable results. Thanks for the feedback, and see you on the Bridge!

changes.text: NEW Sale Restriction: You cannot sell Hydra Items when having this augment
changes.label: NEW Sale Restriction
changes.before: You cannot sell Hydra Items when having this augment

changes.text: Fixed a bug where item damage triggers the cleave effect when you have Upgrade Ravenous Hydra.
Fixed a bug where En Passant fail to function when two or more players have it on the same team.
Fixed a bug where Viego can get multiple Tiamat when possessing others while having Ultra Hydra.
Fixed a bug where extra gold can be gained by selling and re-purchasing a Hydra item with Ultra Hydra augment equipped.
Fixed a bug where players can purchase multiple Ravenous Hydra and gain Upgrade Ravenous Hydra lifesteal on all three when paired with Quest: Ultra Hydra.
Fixed a bug where Clown College's Deceive dealt incorrect damage with critical strike ratio.
Fixed a bug where Rite of Ascension may seal enhanced abilities.
Fixed a bug where Baron Nashor's max stacks of Void Corruption was higher than intended.
Fixed a bug where Serpent's Fang's Shield Reaver damage applied Omnivamp.
Fixed a bug where Diana's R VFX may not play properly around different areas of the map.
Fixed a bug where Viego possessing Kled could result in an infinite looping sound effect.
